name: Meadow Vase
finished_size: About 12 cm tall and 10 cm across at the widest point

yarn.description: Cotton-blend yarn for a firm textured vase

additional_materials: Optional straight-sided glass jar, maximum 5 cm diameter and 10 cm tall
gauge: 20 sc and 22 rnds = 10 cm in sc. Check the width against the optional jar before completing the neck.

steps.label: Rnd 1
steps.text: Make an MR and work 6 sc into the ring. Place a stitch marker in the first st to mark the start of each continuous rnd.

steps.label: Rnd 2
steps.text: Work 2 sc in each st around.

steps.label: Rnd 3
steps.text: Work (sc in next st, 2 sc in next st) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 4
steps.text: Work (sc in each of next 2 sts, 2 sc in next st) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 5
steps.text: Work (sc in each of next 3 sts, 2 sc in next st) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 6
steps.text: Work (sc in each of next 4 sts, 2 sc in next st) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 7
steps.text: Work (sc in each of next 5 sts, 2 sc in next st) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 8
steps.text: Work (sc in each of next 6 sts, 2 sc in next st) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 9
steps.text: Work (sc in each of next 7 sts, 2 sc in next st) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 10
steps.text: Working in BLO, sc in each st around to turn the work upwards.

steps.label: Rnd 11
steps.text: Work (hdc in each of next 8 sts, 2 hdc in next st) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnds 12-17
steps.text: Hdc in each st around for each rnd.

steps.label: Rnd 18
steps.text: Work (hdc in each of next 8 sts, hdc2tog) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 20
steps.text: Work (hdc in each of next 7 sts, hdc2tog) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 21
steps.text: Work (hdc in each of next 6 sts, hdc2tog) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnd 22
steps.text: Work (hdc in each of next 5 sts, hdc2tog) 6 times.

steps.label: Rnds 23-27
steps.text: Hdc in each st around for each rnd.

finishing: Fasten off after Rnd 27, leaving a 15 cm yarn tail.
Weave in the starting and finishing tails securely on the inside without pulling the fabric out of shape.
Gently shape the rounded body and narrow neck with your hands.
For fresh flowers or water, place a suitably sized glass jar inside the crochet vase before arranging stems.
notes: Work all rnds in a continuous spiral; do not join at the end of a rnd.
The crochet vessel is intended for everlasting crochet, dried, or artificial stems when used without a glass jar.
Keep the tension firm, especially on the base, so the vase stands neatly around its insert or arrangement.
